description:
Integrated geospatial software system for monitoring and modeling the earth system.


This release contains the latest version of TerrSet liberaGIS (v20.06). You can download the setup file at the bottom of this section (in Assets). Microsoft Access Database Engine is also included for download in case you need the Microsoft Distributables for Database Workshop or the SHAPEIDR Shape file import module (usually needed if you don't have MS Office installed on your computer).
Fixed / Added:
Changes in TerrSet liberaGIS v20.06:
- CROSSTAB
  - In v.20.04, a fix was made to make CROSSTAB take background values into account in more cases. However, that fix assumed that if one image had a background value, the other did too, so there were problems if that was not the case. Now it will correctly take background values into account, whether there is a mask or not, whether the images are byte or integer, and whether one image's background value does not match the other's or one image has a background value and the other does not.
